#Background
This contains many random forest models. After the "set up" section is run, each model should be able to be run independently without running all other models. As such, the same seed is set in multiple places throughout the script so that each section is reproducible. 

#set up

## Packages

```{r Packages}

#if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
#  install.packages("BiocManager")
#BiocManager::install()

#"phyloseq" for handling phylseq objects
#BiocManager::install("phyloseq")
library(phyloseq)

#"tidyverse" for data organization
#install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)

#"here" for easily locating files
#install.packages("here")
library(here)

#"tidymodels" for random forest models
#install.packages("tidymodels")
library(tidymodels)

#"vip" for identifying most important predictors of random forest models
#install.packages("vip")
library(vip)

#"labdsv" for hellinger formula
#install.packages("labdsv")
library(labdsv)

#"pRPC" for ROC curves
#install.packages("pROC")
library(pROC)
```

## Load data
```{r Loading data}
#loading data

load(here("results/filtered_dada_2_output_environment.RData"))

```


## Data organization
### Extracting information into data frames

```{r Sample data to data frame}
sample_data <- ps_analysis_2@sam_data
sample_data <- data.frame(sample_ata)
sample_data <- tibble::rownames_to_column(sample_data, var = "Sample.ID")

nrow(sample_data) #237

#filtering out twins
sample_data <- sample_data %>% 
  filter(Twins == 2)
nrow(sample_data) #235

```

```{r ASVs to data frame}
# Extract ASV information.
ASVs <- data.frame(ps_analysis_2@otu_table)


#Perform Hellinger data transformation (Hdt) transformation on ASVs.
ASVs_Hdt <- as.data.frame(labdsv::hellinger(ASVs))


#Removing ASVs in less than 10% of samples
ASVs_Hdt_10 <- ASVs_Hdt %>% 
  keep(~ (sum(. <= 0) / length(.)) < 0.9)

ASVs_Hdt_10 <- tibble::rownames_to_column(ASVs_Hdt_10, var = "Sample.ID")


```

### Seperating/combining information into data frames based on categories

```{r birth outcomes data frame}
#combining large for gestational age into the "normal" category
#defining SVN to exclude those with miscarriages etc. 
Birth_outcomes <- select(sample_data, Sample.ID, MTP, miscarriage, Stillbirth, Born_Alive, Infant_death, Percential_weight.GA, Birth_weight_cat, GA_birth_binary, GA_birth, Birth_weight) %>% 
  mutate(Percential_weight.GA_2 = case_when(Percential_weight.GA == "normal" | Percential_weight.GA == "LGA" ~ "Normal", Percential_weight.GA == "SGA" ~ "SGA")) %>% 
   mutate(SVN = case_when(Percential_weight.GA_2 == "SGA" | Birth_weight_cat == "Low Birth Weight" | GA_birth_binary == "Preterm" ~ "SVN", .default = "Other")) %>% 
  mutate(Single_outcome_SVN = case_when(Born_Alive == "1" & Percential_weight.GA_2 == "Normal" & Birth_weight_cat == "Normal Weight" & GA_birth_binary == "Term" ~ "Healthy", Born_Alive == "1" & SVN == "SVN" ~ "SVN", .default = "Other"))


```



# RF models: microbiome ASVs as predictors

## SVN

```{r create data frame with all variables of interest}
Birth_outcomes_SVN <- select(Birth_outcomes, Sample.ID, Single_outcome_SVN) 

SVN_rf_df <- Birth_outcomes_SVN %>% 
  full_join(ASVs_Hdt_10) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "Sample.ID")  %>% 
  filter(Single_outcome_SVN != "Other")

nrow(SVN_rf_df)

```

### build a model
```{r training and testing sets}

# Set seed for reproducibility.
#sample(1:10000, 1)
set.seed(9587)

#creating training/testing sets. stratifying by outcome of interest so that the training and testing sets have the same proportion of that condition. 

Data_split_SVN <- rsample::initial_split(SVN_rf_df, prop = 7/10, strata = Single_outcome_SVN) 
Data_train_SVN <- rsample::training(Data_split_SVN) 
Data_test_SVN <- rsample::testing(Data_split_SVN)

```

```{r resampling sets}

# Set seed for reproducibility.
#sample(1:10000, 1)
set.seed(9587)

#resampling via bootstrap
Data_folds_SVN <- rsample::bootstraps(Data_train_SVN, strata = Single_outcome_SVN)

Data_folds_SVN

```

```{ referencing best practices for code}

#install.packages("usemodels")
library(usemodels)

use_ranger(Single_outcome_SVN ~ ., data = Data_train_SO_SVN_2)

```

```{r Creating model}
#creating workflow for SVN RF model. 
ranger_recipe_SVN <- 
  recipe(formula = Single_outcome_SVN ~ ., data = Data_train_SVN)%>% 
  step_novel() 

ranger_spec_SVN <- 
  rand_forest(mtry = tune(), min_n = tune(), trees = 1000) %>% 
  set_mode("classification") %>% 
  set_engine("ranger") 

ranger_workflow_SVN <- 
  workflow() %>% 
  add_recipe(ranger_recipe_SVN) %>% 
  add_model(ranger_spec_SVN) 

#sample(1:10000, 1)
set.seed(9587)
ranger_tune_SVN <-
  tune_grid(ranger_workflow_SVN, resamples = Data_folds_SVN, grid = 10)

```


```{r Identifying best random forest model}
#visualizing metrics for each parameter  
show_best(ranger_tune_SVN, metric = "roc_auc")

autoplot(ranger_tune_SVN)

```


```{r Selecting final random forest model}
#selecting best parameters for random forest model based on AUC 
final_rf_SVN <- ranger_workflow_SVN %>% 
  finalize_workflow(select_best(ranger_tune_SVN))

final_rf_SVN

```


```{r fiting the model}

set.seed(9587)

Data_fit_SVN <- last_fit(final_rf_SVN, Data_split_SVN)

Data_fit_SVN

```
#### Outcomes

```{r}
#Showing metrics

collect_metrics(Data_fit_SVN)

#the metrics from the best model using the training set
show_best(ranger_tune_SVN, metric = "accuracy")  
show_best(ranger_tune_SVN, metric = "roc_auc")  
show_best(ranger_tune_SVN, metric = "brier_class") 

#graphing roc curve
SVN_predictions <- collect_predictions(Data_fit_SVN)

roc_curve(SVN_predictions,
          truth = Single_outcome_SVN,
          .pred_Healthy)%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity)) +
  geom_path() +
  geom_abline(lty = 3) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme( axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20))

```

```{r Best Predictors}

# Set seed for reproducibility.
#sample(1:10000, 1)
set.seed(9587)


#running the same model as before but so that the importance will be calculated
ranger_spec_SVNb <- ranger_spec_SVN %>% 
  finalize_model(select_best(ranger_tune_SVN)) %>% 
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "permutation")

ranger_workflow_SVNb <- workflow() %>% 
  add_recipe(ranger_recipe_SVN) %>% 
  add_model(ranger_spec_SVNb) %>% 
  fit(Data_train_SVN) %>% 
  pull_workflow_fit()

ranger_workflow_SVNb %>%  vip()


importance_SVN <- ranger_workflow_SVNb %>% vi()



```

```{r Viewing best predictors with taxonomy}

#importance of each ASV predictor into data frame
importance_SVN <- ranger_workflow_SVNb %>% vi()


# Add taxonomic assignments to importance rankings.
tax_SVN <- data.frame(ps_analysis_2@tax_table)
tax_SVN <- tibble::rownames_to_column(tax_SVN, var = "ASV")
tax_SVN <- tax_SVN %>% rename(Variable = ASV)

importance_tax_SVN <- dplyr::left_join(importance_SVN, tax_SVN, by = "Variable")

#removing all importance values less than 0.
importance_tax_SVN <- importance_tax_SVN %>%
  mutate(
    Importance = pmax(Importance, 0)  # clip negatives to zero
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Importance))

#calculating the cumulative of the importance score
total_importance_SVN <- sum(importance_tax_SVN$Importance)


#calculating cumulative importance for each asv (by importance ranking) and percent of total immportance
importance_tax_SVN <- importance_tax_SVN %>%
  mutate(
    cumulative_raw = cumsum(Importance),
    cumulative_importance = cumulative_raw / total_importance_SVN,
    importance_percent = Importance / total_importance_SVN,
    rank = row_number()
  )

max(importance_tax_SVN$cumulative_importance)

importance_tax_SVN$Name <- paste(importance_tax_SVN$Variable, ",", importance_tax_SVN$Family)




#identifying at which ASV 80% of total cumulative importance is reached
importance_threshold_SVN <- 0.80  # for 80% cumulative importance

top_vars_needed_SVN <- importance_tax_SVN %>%
  mutate(row = row_number()) %>%
  filter(cumulative_importance >= importance_threshold_SVN) %>%
  slice(1)

top_vars_needed_SVN

#graphing cumulative importance
ggplot(importance_tax_SVN, aes(x = rank, y = cumulative_importance)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = "darkblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(
    x = "Number of Top Variables",
    y = "Cumulative Importance",
    title = "Cumulative Variable Importance (SVN)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()





#graphing importance for each ASV
tax_SVN <- data.frame(ps_analysis_2@tax_table)
tax_SVN <- tibble::rownames_to_column(tax_SVN, var = "Variable")

SVN_plot_importance_tax_SVN <- dplyr::left_join(importance_SVN, tax_SVN, by = "Variable") %>%
  mutate(Genus   = ifelse(is.na(Genus), "Unclassified", Genus),
         Family  = ifelse(is.na(Family), "Unclassified", Family)) %>% 
  mutate(ASV_pad    = str_pad(Variable, width = 6, side = "right"),
         Family_pad = str_pad(Family, width = 20, side = "right"),
         TaxLabel   = paste(ASV_pad, Family_pad, sep = "|"))


#graphing importance for each of the top ASVs
ggplot(SVN_plot_importance_tax_SVN[1:23,], aes(x = Importance, y = reorder(TaxLabel, Importance), fill = Importance)) +
  geom_col()+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "Importance", 
       y = "Top 23 ASV Predictors (ASV | Family)", 
       title = "SVN Random Forest: ASVs by Importance")+
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, family = "mono"))

```



```{r diverging bar plot}
#data frame with only top asvs
SVN_TP_23 <- importance_tax_SVN %>% 
  slice(1:23) %>% 
  pull(1) %>% 
  as.character()  

SVN_rf_df_TP_23 <- ASVs_Hdt_10 %>% 
  select(Sample.ID, all_of(SVN_TP_23)) %>% 
  full_join(Birth_outcomes_SVN) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "Sample.ID")  %>% 
  filter(Single_outcome_SVN != "Other")
  

nrow(SVN_rf_df_TP_23)


# Summarize average relative abundance per group
SVN_summary_df <- SVN_rf_df_TP_23 %>%
  rownames_to_column(var= "Sample.ID") %>% 
  pivot_longer(!c(Sample.ID, Single_outcome_SVN), names_to = "ASV") %>%
  group_by(ASV, Single_outcome_SVN) %>%
  summarize(MeanAbundance = mean(value)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Single_outcome_SVN, values_from = MeanAbundance) %>%
  mutate(Difference = SVN - Healthy)

# Run Wilcoxon tests for each taxon
SVN_stat_results <- SVN_rf_df_TP_23 %>%
  rownames_to_column(var= "Sample.ID") %>% 
  pivot_longer(!c(Sample.ID, Single_outcome_SVN), names_to = "ASV") %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = wilcox.test(value ~ Single_outcome_SVN)$p.value
  ) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BY"),  
         significance = case_when(
           p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
           p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
           p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
           TRUE ~ ""
         ))

SVN_plot_df <- left_join(SVN_summary_df, SVN_stat_results, by = "ASV")

# Add taxonomic assignments to importance rankings.
tax_SVN <- data.frame(ps_analysis_2@tax_table)
tax_SVN <- tibble::rownames_to_column(tax_SVN, var = "ASV")

#formatting labels
SVN_plot_df_tax_SVN <- dplyr::left_join(SVN_plot_df, tax_SVN, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(Genus   = ifelse(is.na(Genus), "Unclassified", Genus),
         Family  = ifelse(is.na(Family), "Unclassified", Family)) %>% 
  mutate(ASV_pad    = str_pad(ASV, width = 6, side = "right"),
         Family_pad = str_pad(Family, width = 20, side = "right"),
         TaxLabel   = paste(ASV_pad, Family_pad, sep = "|"))

#graphing difference in reletive abundance between SVN and healthy for top asvs
ggplot(SVN_plot_df_tax_SVN, aes(x = reorder(TaxLabel, Difference), y = Difference, fill = Difference > 0)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = significance), hjust = ifelse(SVN_plot_df_tax_SVN$Difference > 0, -0.2, 1.2)) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "steelblue", "FALSE" = "tomato")) +
  labs(title = "Microbiome Relative Abundance: SVN vs. Healthy",
       x = "Top 23 ASV Predictors (ASV | Family)",
       y = "Difference in Relative Abundance") +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.position="none", axis.text.y = element_text(family = "mono"), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15))

```



## AGP

```{r create data frame with all variables of interest}
#creating a dataframe with necessary variables

Birth_outcomes_SVN <- select(Birth_outcomes, Sample.ID, Single_outcome_SVN) 

Serology_AGP <- select(sample_data, Sample.ID, inflammation_AGP_cat) 

AGP_rf_df <- Birth_outcomes_SVN %>% 
  full_join(ASVs_Hdt_10) %>% 
  full_join(Serology_AGP) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "Sample.ID")  %>% 
  filter(Single_outcome_SVN != "Other") %>% 
  select(-Single_outcome_SVN)

nrow(AGP_rf_df)

```

### build a model
```{r training and testing sets}

# Set seed for reproducibility.
#sample(1:10000, 1)
set.seed(9587)

#creating training/testing sets. stratifying by outcome of interest so that the training and testing sets have the same proportion of that condition. 

Data_split_APG <- rsample::initial_split(AGP_rf_df, prop = 7/10, strata = inflammation_AGP_cat) 
Data_train_APG <- rsample::training(Data_split_APG) 
Data_test_APG <- rsample::testing(Data_split_APG)




```

```{r resampling sets}

# Set seed for reproducibility.
#sample(1:10000, 1)
set.seed(9587)

#resampling via bootstrap
Data_folds_APG <- rsample::bootstraps(Data_train_APG, strata = inflammation_AGP_cat)

Data_folds_APG

```

```{ referencing best practices for code}

#install.packages("usemodels")
library(usemodels)

use_ranger(inflammation_AGP_cat ~ ., data = Data_train_APG)

```

```{r Creating model}
#creating workflow for AGP RF model.
ranger_recipe_APG <- 
  recipe(formula = inflammation_AGP_cat ~ ., data = Data_train_APG) %>% 
  step_novel()

ranger_spec_APG <- 
  rand_forest(mtry = tune(), min_n = tune(), trees = 1000) %>% 
  set_mode("classification") %>% 
  set_engine("ranger") 

ranger_workflow_APG <- 
  workflow() %>% 
  add_recipe(ranger_recipe_APG) %>% 
  add_model(ranger_spec_APG) 

#sample(1:10000, 1)
set.seed(9587)
 
ranger_tune_APG <-
  tune_grid(ranger_workflow_APG, resamples = Data_folds_APG, grid = 10)

```


```{r Identifying best random forest model}
#visualizing metrics for each parameter   
show_best(ranger_tune_APG, metric = "roc_auc")

autoplot(ranger_tune_APG)

```


```{r Selecting final random forest model}
#selecting best parameters for random forest model based on AUC
final_rf_APG <- ranger_workflow_APG %>% 
  finalize_workflow(select_best(ranger_tune_APG))

final_rf_APG

```


```{r fiting the model}

set.seed(9587) 

Data_fit_APG <- last_fit(final_rf_APG, Data_split_APG)

Data_fit_APG

```

```{r}
show_best(ranger_tune_APG, metric = "roc_auc")  
show_best(ranger_tune_APG, metric = "brier_class")

```

## CRP

```{r create data frame with all variables of interest}
Birth_outcomes_SVN <- select(Birth_outcomes, Sample.ID, Single_outcome_SVN) 

Serology_CRP <- select(sample_data, Sample.ID, inflammation_CRP_cat) 

CRP_rf_df <- Birth_outcomes_SVN %>% 
  full_join(ASVs_Hdt_10) %>% 
  full_join(Serology_CRP) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "Sample.ID")  %>% 
  filter(Single_outcome_SVN != "Other") %>% 
  select(-Single_outcome_SVN)

nrow(CRP_rf_df) 

```

### build a model
```{r training and testing sets}

# Set seed for reproducibility.
#sample(1:10000, 1)
set.seed(9587)

#creating training/testing sets. stratifying by outcome of interest so that the training and testing sets have the same proportion of that condition. 

Data_split_CRP <- rsample::initial_split(CRP_rf_df, prop = 7/10, strata = inflammation_CRP_cat) 
Data_train_CRP <- rsample::training(Data_split_CRP) 
Data_test_CRP <- rsample::testing(Data_split_CRP)




```

```{r resampling sets}

# Set seed for reproducibility.
#sample(1:10000, 1)
set.seed(9587)

#resampling via bootstrap
Data_folds_CRP <- rsample::bootstraps(Data_train_CRP, strata = inflammation_CRP_cat)

Data_folds_CRP

```

```{ referencing best practices for code}

#install.packages("usemodels")
library(usemodels)

use_ranger(inflammation_CRP_cat ~ ., data = Data_train_CRP)

```

```{r Creating model}
#creating workflow for CRP RF model.
ranger_recipe_CRP <- 
  recipe(formula = inflammation_CRP_cat ~ ., data = Data_train_CRP) %>% 
  step_novel()

ranger_spec_CRP <- 
  rand_forest(mtry = tune(), min_n = tune(), trees = 1000) %>% 
  set_mode("classification") %>% 
  set_engine("ranger") 

ranger_workflow_CRP <- 
  workflow() %>% 
  add_recipe(ranger_recipe_CRP) %>% 
  add_model(ranger_spec_CRP) 

#sample(1:10000, 1)
set.seed(9587)
 
ranger_tune_CRP <-
  tune_grid(ranger_workflow_CRP, resamples = Data_folds_CRP, grid = 10)

```


```{r Identifying best random forest model}
#visualizing metrics for each parameter  
show_best(ranger_tune_CRP, metric = "roc_auc")

autoplot(ranger_tune_CRP)

```


```{r Selecting final random forest model}
#selecting best parameters for random forest model based on AUC
final_rf_CRP <- ranger_workflow_CRP %>% 
  finalize_workflow(select_best(ranger_tune_CRP))

final_rf_CRP

```


```{r fiting the model}

set.seed(9587) 

Data_fit_CRP <- last_fit(final_rf_CRP, Data_split_CRP)

Data_fit_CRP

```
#### Outcomes

```{r}
#collecting metrics
collect_metrics(Data_fit_CRP)

#metrics of the best model with testing set
show_best(ranger_tune_CRP, metric = "accuracy")  
show_best(ranger_tune_CRP, metric = "roc_auc")  
show_best(ranger_tune_CRP, metric = "brier_class") 

#plotting ROC curve
CRP_predictions <- collect_predictions(Data_fit_CRP)

roc_curve(CRP_predictions,
          truth = inflammation_CRP_cat,
          ".pred_Elevated CRP")%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity)) +
  geom_path() +
  geom_abline(lty = 3) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_bw()


```

```{r Viewing best predictors with taxonomy}
#data frame of importance values
importance_cal <- ranger_workflow_calb %>% vi()


# Add taxonomic assignments to importance rankings.
tax_cal <- data.frame(ps_analysis_2@tax_table)
tax_cal <- tibble::rownames_to_column(tax_cal, var = "ASV")
tax_cal <- tax_cal %>% rename(Variable = ASV)

importance_tax_cal <- dplyr::left_join(importance_cal, tax_cal, by = "Variable")

#removing importance scores <0
importance_tax_cal <- importance_tax_cal %>%
  mutate(
    Importance = pmax(Importance, 0)  # clip negatives to zero
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Importance))


#Total importance
total_importance_cal <- sum(importance_tax_cal$Importance)


#cumulative importance at each ASV
importance_tax_cal <- importance_tax_cal %>%
  mutate(
    cumulative_raw = cumsum(Importance),
    cumulative_importance = cumulative_raw / total_importance_cal,
    importance_percent = Importance / total_importance_cal,
    rank = row_number()
  )

max(importance_tax_cal$cumulative_importance)

importance_tax_cal$Name <- paste(importance_tax_cal$Variable, ",", importance_tax_cal$Family)





#Identifying the predictor at which 80% of cumulative importance is reached
importance_threshold_cal <- 0.80  # for 80% cumulative importance

top_vars_needed_cal <- importance_tax_cal %>%
  mutate(row = row_number()) %>%
  filter(cumulative_importance >= importance_threshold_cal) %>%
  slice(1)

top_vars_needed_cal

#plotting importance by predictor
ggplot(importance_tax_cal, aes(x = rank, y = cumulative_importance)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = "darkblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(
    x = "Number of Top Variables",
    y = "Cumulative Importance",
    title = "Cumulative Variable Importance (Calprotectin)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


#plotting top predictors
ggplot(importance_cal[1:21,], aes(x = Importance, y = reorder(Variable, Importance), fill = Importance)) +
  geom_col()+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "Importance", y = "ASV", title = "Calprotectin Random Forest: ASVs by Importance")+
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))

tax_SVN <- data.frame(ps_analysis_2@tax_table)
tax_SVN <- tibble::rownames_to_column(tax_SVN, var = "Variable")

cal_plot_importance_tax_cal <- dplyr::left_join(importance_cal, tax_SVN, by = "Variable") %>%
  mutate(Genus   = ifelse(is.na(Genus), "Unclassified", Genus),
         Family  = ifelse(is.na(Family), "Unclassified", Family)) %>% 
  mutate(ASV_pad    = str_pad(Variable, width = 6, side = "right"),
         Family_pad = str_pad(Family, width = 25, side = "right"),
         TaxLabel   = paste(ASV_pad, Family_pad, sep = "|"))



ggplot(cal_plot_importance_tax_cal[1:21,], aes(x = Importance, y = reorder(TaxLabel, Importance), fill = Importance)) +
  geom_col()+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "Importance", 
       y = "Top 21 ASV Predictors (ASV | Family)", 
       title = "Calprotectin Random Forest: ASVs by Importance")+
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, family = "mono"))

```








```{r diverging bar plot}

cal_TP_21 <- importance_tax_cal %>% 
  slice(1:21) %>% 
  pull(1) %>% 
  as.character()  # Ensure it's a clean character vector


#create data frame with all variables of interest
cal_rf_df_TP_21 <- ASVs_Hdt_10 %>%
  select(Sample.ID, all_of(cal_TP_21)) %>% 
  full_join(Birth_outcomes_SVN) %>% 
  full_join(Serology_Calprotectin) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "Sample.ID")  %>% 
  filter(Single_outcome_SVN != "Other") %>% 
  select(-Single_outcome_SVN)


# Summarize average relative abundance per group
cal_summary_df <- cal_rf_df_TP_21 %>%
  rownames_to_column(var= "Sample.ID") %>% 
  pivot_longer(!c(Sample.ID, inflammation_calprotectin_cat), names_to = "ASV") %>%
  group_by(ASV, inflammation_calprotectin_cat) %>%
  summarize(MeanAbundance = mean(value)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = inflammation_calprotectin_cat, values_from = MeanAbundance) %>%
  mutate(Difference = `Elevated Calprotectin` - `Normal Calprotectin`)

# Run Wilcoxon tests for each taxon
cal_stat_results <- cal_rf_df_TP_21 %>%
  rownames_to_column(var= "Sample.ID") %>% 
  pivot_longer(!c(Sample.ID, inflammation_calprotectin_cat), names_to = "ASV") %>%
  group_by(ASV) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = wilcox.test(value ~ inflammation_calprotectin_cat)$p.value
  ) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BY"),  
         significance = case_when(
           p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
           p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
           p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
           TRUE ~ ""
         ))

cal_plot_df <- left_join(cal_summary_df, cal_stat_results, by = "ASV")

# Add taxonomic assignments to importance rankings.
tax_cal <- data.frame(ps_analysis_2@tax_table)
tax_cal <- tibble::rownames_to_column(tax_cal, var = "ASV")

cal_plot_df_tax_cal <- dplyr::left_join(cal_plot_df, tax_cal, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(Genus   = ifelse(is.na(Genus), "Unclassified", Genus),
         Family  = ifelse(is.na(Family), "Unclassified", Family)) %>% 
  mutate(ASV_pad    = str_pad(ASV, width = 6, side = "right"),
         Family_pad = str_pad(Family, width = 25, side = "right"),
         TaxLabel   = paste(ASV_pad, Family_pad, sep = "|"))

ggplot(cal_plot_df_tax_cal, aes(x = reorder(TaxLabel, Difference), y = Difference, fill = Difference > 0)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = significance), hjust = ifelse(cal_plot_df_tax_cal$Difference > 0, -0.2, 1.2)) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "steelblue", "FALSE" = "tomato")) +
  labs(title = "Microbiome Relative Abundance: Elevated Calprotectin",
       x = "Top 21 ASV Predictors (ASV | Family)",
       y = "Difference in Relative Abundance") +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.position="none", axis.text.y = element_text(family = "mono"), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15))



```













## RF ROC curves for all 5 features of interest

```{r}
#metrics for each RF model
collect_metrics(Data_fit_APG)

collect_metrics(Data_fit_CRP)

collect_metrics(Data_fit_Anemia)

collect_metrics(Data_fit_EPEC)

collect_metrics(Data_fit_cal)

#ROC curves for each RF model
AGP_ROC <- roc_curve(AGP_predictions, truth = inflammation_AGP_cat, ".pred_Elevated AGP")%>%
  mutate(model = "Elevated AGP")

CRP_ROC <- roc_curve(CRP_predictions, truth = inflammation_CRP_cat, ".pred_Elevated CRP")%>%
  mutate(model = "Elevated CRP")

Anemia_ROC <- roc_curve(Anemia_predictions, truth = Anemia_Binary, ".pred_Anemia")%>%
  mutate(model = "Anemia")

aEPEC_ROC <- roc_curve(aEPEC_predictions, truth = aEPEC_cat, ".pred_Positive")%>%
  mutate(model = "aEPEC")

cal_ROC <- roc_curve(cal_predictions, truth = inflammation_calprotectin_cat, ".pred_Elevated Calprotectin")%>%
  mutate(model = "Elevated Calprotectin")

ROC_maternal <- bind_rows(AGP_ROC, CRP_ROC, Anemia_ROC, aEPEC_ROC, cal_ROC) %>% 
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("Elevated AGP", "Elevated CRP", "Anemia", "aEPEC", "Elevated Calprotectin")))

#AUCs as labels 
custom_label_maternal <- c("AUC = 0.742", "AUC = 0.554", "AUC = 0.595", "AUC = 0.447", "AUC = 0.793")

#plotting RF models
panel_labels_maternal <- ROC_maternal %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarize() %>% 
  mutate(label = custom_label_maternal)


ggplot(ROC_maternal, aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity)) +
  geom_path(aes(), size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ model, nrow = 1) +
  geom_abline(lty = 3, color = "gray", size = 1.5) +
  geom_text(data = panel_labels_maternal,
            aes(x = .4, y = .2, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 6) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title.x = element_text(size = 30), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 30), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15),axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15), strip.text = element_text(size = 15) )


```





```{r}
#statistics for each RF model
# SVN
truth_1 <- SVN_predictions$Single_outcome_SVN 
truth_1 <- factor(truth_1, levels = c("SVN", "Healthy"))
score_1 <- SVN_predictions$.pred_SVN
roc1 <- roc(truth_1, score_1, levels = c("SVN", "Healthy"), direction = ">")
auc(roc1)
ci.auc(roc1)
ci_roc1 <- ci.se(roc1, specificities = seq(0, 1, 0.01))



# AGP
truth_AGP <- AGP_predictions$inflammation_AGP_cat
truth_AGP <- factor(truth_AGP, levels = c("Elevated AGP", "Normal AGP"))
score_AGP <- AGP_predictions$".pred_Elevated AGP"
rocAGP <- roc(truth_AGP, score_AGP, levels = c("Elevated AGP", "Normal AGP"), direction = ">")
auc(rocAGP)
ci.auc(rocAGP)
ci_rocAGP <- ci.se(rocAGP, specificities = seq(0, 1, 0.01))


# CRP
truth_CRP <- CRP_predictions$inflammation_CRP_cat 
truth_CRP <- factor(truth_CRP, levels = c("Elevated CRP", "Normal CRP"))
score_CRP <- CRP_predictions$".pred_Elevated CRP"
rocCRP <- roc(truth_CRP, score_CRP, levels = c("Elevated CRP", "Normal CRP"), direction = ">")
auc(rocCRP)
ci.auc(rocCRP)
ci_rocCRP <- ci.se(rocCRP, specificities = seq(0, 1, 0.01))



# Anemia
truth_Anemia <- Anemia_predictions$Anemia_Binary 
truth_Anemia <- factor(truth_Anemia, levels = c("Anemia", "No_Anemia"))
score_Anemia <- Anemia_predictions$.pred_Anemia
rocAnemia <- roc(truth_Anemia, score_Anemia, levels = c("Anemia", "No_Anemia"), direction = ">")
auc(rocAnemia)
ci.auc(rocAnemia)
ci_rocAnemia <- ci.se(rocAnemia, specificities = seq(0, 1, 0.01))



# aEPEC
truth_aEPEC <- aEPEC_predictions$aEPEC_cat
truth_aEPEC <- factor(truth_aEPEC, levels = c("Positive", "Negative"))
score_aEPEC <- aEPEC_predictions$.pred_Positive
rocaEPEC <- roc(truth_aEPEC, score_aEPEC, levels = c("Positive", "Negative"), direction = ">")
auc(rocaEPEC)
ci.auc(rocaEPEC)
ci_rocaEPEC <- ci.se(rocaEPEC, specificities = seq(0, 1, 0.01))



# calprotectin
truth_cal <- cal_predictions$inflammation_calprotectin_cat 
truth_cal <- factor(truth_cal, levels = c("Elevated Calprotectin", "Normal Calprotectin"))
score_cal <- cal_predictions$".pred_Elevated Calprotectin"
roccal <- roc(truth_cal, score_cal, levels = c("Elevated Calprotectin", "Normal Calprotectin"), direction = ">")
auc(roccal)

ci_roccal <- ci.se(roccal, specificities = seq(0, 1, 0.01))
```

# RF models: microbiome + maternal features as predictors

## SVN with AGP

```{r create data frame with all variables of interest}
Birth_outcomes_SVN <- select(Birth_outcomes, Sample.ID, Single_outcome_SVN) 

Serology_AGP <- select(sample_data, Sample.ID, inflammation_AGP_cat) 

SVN_rf_df_2 <- ASVs_Hdt_10 %>%
  full_join(Birth_outcomes_SVN) %>% 
  full_join(Serology_AGP) %>% 
  mutate(inflammation_AGP_cat = factor(inflammation_AGP_cat, levels = c("Normal AGP", "Elevated AGP"))) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "Sample.ID")  %>% 
  filter(Single_outcome_SVN != "Other")

nrow(SVN_rf_df_2 )


```

### build a model
```{r training and testing sets}

# Set seed for reproducibility.
#sample(1:10000, 1)
set.seed(9587)

#creating training/testing sets. stratifying by outcome of interest so that the training and testing sets have the same proportion of that condition. 

Data_split_SVN_2  <- rsample::initial_split(SVN_rf_df_2 , prop = 7/10, strata = Single_outcome_SVN) 
Data_train_SVN_2  <- rsample::training(Data_split_SVN_2 ) 
Data_test_SVN_2  <- rsample::testing(Data_split_SVN_2 )




```

```{r resampling sets}

# Set seed for reproducibility.
#sample(1:10000, 1)
set.seed(9587)

#resampling via bootstrap
Data_folds_SVN_2  <- rsample::bootstraps(Data_train_SVN_2 , strata = Single_outcome_SVN)

Data_folds_SVN_2 

```

```{ referencing best practices for code}

#install.packages("usemodels")
library(usemodels)

use_ranger(Single_outcome_SVN ~ ., data = Data_train_SVN_2)

```

```{r Creating model}
#creating workflow for SVN RF model with microbiome and AGP.
ranger_recipe_SVN_2  <- 
  recipe(formula = Single_outcome_SVN ~ ., data = Data_train_SVN_2) %>% 
  step_novel()

ranger_spec_SVN_2  <- 
  rand_forest(mtry = tune(), min_n = tune(), trees = 1000) %>% 
  set_mode("classification") %>% 
  set_engine("ranger") 

ranger_workflow_SVN_2  <- 
  workflow() %>% 
  add_recipe(ranger_recipe_SVN_2) %>% 
  add_model(ranger_spec_SVN_2) 

#sample(1:10000, 1)
set.seed(9587)
 
ranger_tune_SVN_2  <-
  tune_grid(ranger_workflow_SVN_2, resamples = Data_folds_SVN_2, grid = 10)

```


```{r Identifying best random forest model}
#visualizing metrics for each parameter
show_best(ranger_tune_SVN_2, metric = "roc_auc")

autoplot(ranger_tune_SVN_2)

```


```{r Selecting final random forest model}
#selecting best parameters for random forest model based on AUC
final_rf_SVN_2 <- ranger_workflow_SVN_2 %>% 
  finalize_workflow(select_best(ranger_tune_SVN_2))

final_rf_SVN_2

```


```{r fiting the model}

set.seed(9587) 

Data_fit_SVN_2 <- last_fit(final_rf_SVN_2, Data_split_SVN_2)

Data_fit_SVN_2

```
#### Outcomes

```{r}
#collecting metrics

collect_metrics(Data_fit_SVN_2)

#the metrics of the best model using the training set
show_best(ranger_tune_SVN_2, metric = "accuracy")  
show_best(ranger_tune_SVN_2, metric = "roc_auc")  
show_best(ranger_tune_SVN_2, metric = "brier_class") 


#plotting ROC curve
SVN_predictions_2 <- collect_predictions(Data_fit_SVN_2)

roc_curve(SVN_predictions_2,
          truth = Single_outcome_SVN,
          .pred_Healthy)%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity)) +
  geom_path() +
  geom_abline(lty = 3) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_bw()



```

## graphing AUCs

```{r graphing AUCs}

#metrics for each RF model
collect_metrics(Data_fit_SVN)

collect_metrics(Data_fit_SVN_2)

collect_metrics(Data_fit_SVN_3)

collect_metrics(Data_fit_SVN_4)

collect_metrics(Data_fit_SVN_5)

collect_metrics(Data_fit_SVN_6)

collect_metrics(Data_fit_SVN_7)

collect_metrics(Data_fit_SVN_8)

#ROC curve for each RF model
SVN_ROC <- roc_curve(SVN_predictions, truth = Single_outcome_SVN, ".pred_Healthy")%>%
  mutate(model = "Microbiome")

SVN_2_ROC <- roc_curve(SVN_predictions_2, truth = Single_outcome_SVN, ".pred_Healthy")%>%
  mutate(model = "Microbiome + AGP")

SVN_3_ROC <- roc_curve(SVN_predictions_3, truth = Single_outcome_SVN, ".pred_Healthy")%>%
  mutate(model = "Microbiome + CRP")

SVN_4_ROC <- roc_curve(SVN_predictions_4, truth = Single_outcome_SVN, ".pred_Healthy")%>%
  mutate(model = "Microbiome + Anemia")

SVN_5_ROC <- roc_curve(SVN_predictions_5, truth = Single_outcome_SVN, ".pred_Healthy")%>%
  mutate(model = "Microbiome + aEPEC")

SVN_6_ROC <- roc_curve(SVN_predictions_6, truth = Single_outcome_SVN, ".pred_Healthy")%>%
  mutate(model = "Microbiome + Calprotectin")

SVN_7_ROC <- roc_curve(SVN_predictions_7, truth = Single_outcome_SVN, ".pred_Healthy")%>%
  mutate(model = "Microbiome + BMI")

SVN_8_ROC <- roc_curve(SVN_predictions_8, truth = Single_outcome_SVN, ".pred_Healthy")%>%
  mutate(model = "Microbiome + Wealth Index")

ROC_SVN <- bind_rows(SVN_ROC, SVN_2_ROC, SVN_3_ROC, SVN_4_ROC, SVN_5_ROC, SVN_6_ROC, SVN_7_ROC, SVN_8_ROC) %>% 
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("Microbiome", "Microbiome + AGP", "Microbiome + CRP", "Microbiome + Anemia", "Microbiome + aEPEC", "Microbiome + Calprotectin", "Microbiome + BMI", "Microbiome + Wealth Index")))

#Making AUC into labels
custom_label_SVN <- c("AUC = 0.653", "AUC = 0.660", "AUC = 0.652", "AUC = 0.660", "AUC = 0.657", "AUC = 0.658", "AUC = 0.672", "AUC = 0.655")

#plotting ROC curves 
panel_labels_SVN <- ROC_SVN %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarize() %>% 
  mutate(label = custom_label_SVN)


ggplot(ROC_SVN, aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity)) +
  geom_path(aes(), size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ model, ncol = 3) +
  geom_abline(lty = 3, color = "gray", size = 1.5) +
  geom_text(data = panel_labels_SVN,
            aes(x = .4, y = .2, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 6) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title.x = element_text(size = 30), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 30), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15),axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15), strip.text = element_text(size = 15) )

```

```{r create data frame with all variables of interest}
Birth_outcomes_SVN <- select(Birth_outcomes, Sample.ID, Single_outcome_SVN) 

hist(sample_data$RBP4_ng.ml)

  select(Sample.ID, RBP4_ng.ml) %>% 
  mutate(Y = log(RBP4_ng.ml)) %>% 
  select(-c(RBP4_ng.ml))

hist(df_x$Y)

x_rf_df <- Birth_outcomes_SVN %>% 
  full_join(ASVs_Hdt_10) %>% 
  full_join(df_x) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "Sample.ID")  %>% 
  filter(Single_outcome_SVN != "Other") %>% 
  select(-c(Single_outcome_SVN))

nrow(x_rf_df)

```

### build a model
```{r training and testing sets}

# Set seed for reproducibility.
#sample(1:10000, 1)
set.seed(9587)

#creating training/testing sets. stratifying by outcome of interest so that the training and testing sets have the same proportion of that condition. 

Data_split_x <- rsample::initial_split(x_rf_df, prop = 7/10, strata = Y) 
Data_train_x <- rsample::training(Data_split_x) 
Data_test_x <- rsample::testing(Data_split_x)

```

```{r resampling sets}

# Set seed for reproducibility.
#sample(1:10000, 1)
set.seed(9587)

#resampling via bootstrap
Data_folds_x <- rsample::bootstraps(Data_train_x, strata = Y)

Data_folds_x

```


```{r Creating model}
#creating workflow for RBP4 RF model.

ranger_recipe_x <- 
  recipe(formula = Y ~ ., data = Data_train_x)%>% 
  step_novel() 

ranger_spec_x <- 
  rand_forest(mtry = tune(), min_n = tune(), trees = 1000) %>% 
  set_mode("regression") %>% 
  set_engine("ranger") 

ranger_workflow_x <- 
  workflow() %>% 
  add_recipe(ranger_recipe_x) %>% 
  add_model(ranger_spec_x) 

#sample(1:10000, 1)
set.seed(9587)
ranger_tune_x <-
  tune_grid(ranger_workflow_x, resamples = Data_folds_x, grid = 10)

```


```{r Identifying best random forest model}

autoplot(ranger_tune_x)

```

```{r Selecting final random forest model}
  finalize_workflow(select_best(ranger_tune_x))

final_rf_x

```

```{r training and testing sets}
#creating training/testing sets. stratifying by outcome of interest so that the training and testing sets have the same proportion of that condition. 

Data_split_x4 <- rsample::initial_split(x4_rf_df, prop = 7/10, strata = Y) 
Data_train_x4 <- rsample::training(Data_split_x4) 
Data_test_x4 <- rsample::testing(Data_split_x4)

```

```{r resampling sets}

# Set seed for reproducibility.
#sample(1:10000, 1)
set.seed(9587)

#resampling via bootstrap
Data_folds_x4 <- rsample::bootstraps(Data_train_x4, strata = Y)

Data_folds_x4

```


```{r Creating model}
#creating workflow for ferritin RF model.
ranger_recipe_x4 <- 
  recipe(formula = Y ~ ., data = Data_train_x4)%>% 
  step_novel() 

ranger_spec_x4 <- 
  rand_forest(mtry = tune(), min_n = tune(), trees = 1000) %>% 
  set_mode("regression") %>% 
  set_engine("ranger") 

ranger_workflow_x4 <- 
  workflow() %>% 
  add_recipe(ranger_recipe_x4) %>% 
  add_model(ranger_spec_x4) 

#sample(1:10000, 1)
set.seed(9587)
ranger_tune_x4 <-
  tune_grid(ranger_workflow_x4, resamples = Data_folds_x4, grid = 10)

```


```{r Identifying best random forest model}
#visualizing metrics for each parameter
show_best(ranger_tune_x4, metric = "rsq")

autoplot(ranger_tune_x4)

```


```{r Selecting final random forest model}
#selecting best parameters for random forest model based on r squared value
final_rf_x4 <- ranger_workflow_x4 %>% 
  finalize_workflow(select_best(ranger_tune_x4))

final_rf_x4

```


```{r fiting the model}

set.seed(9587)

Data_fit_x4 <- last_fit(final_rf_x4, Data_split_x4)

Data_fit_x4

```
#### Outcomes

```{r}
#collecting metrics
collect_metrics(Data_fit_x4)
collect_predictions(Data_fit_x4)


#plotting truth vs predicted
collect_predictions(Data_fit_x4) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = .pred, y = Y)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Predicted", y = "Actual")


```
